description: What this demo is built to answer, committed so the README, the tests and the operator read one copy: three turns that stand alone, and three that only work in order.

prompts.message: I only have three 45-minute sessions next week. I want a faster 10K without losing strength. What are my realistic options?
expects: two or three materially different allocation strategies, not three wordings of one week
for each: what it preserves, what it sacrifices, the evidence that makes it valid, and what stays uncertain
no running score, strength score, recovery score, or any other invented number

prompts.message: What changed across the comparable quality runs, and what is still unproven?
expects: the comparable execution trend across the three threshold sessions, read as pace
the cycle's declared 10K measurement answered separately, and as not yet run
the missing per-segment heart rate on two of the three sessions left unknown rather than treated as unchanged

prompts.message: Thursday is no longer available. What would you preserve and what would you give up?
expects: a revision of this session's own exploration, naming what it preserves and what it gives up
no change to any other demo session and none to the fixture underneath them

conversation.why: What three separate conversations cannot show. The second and third turns are unanswerable on their own: 'the second one' and 'the first option' name something said in the first turn, and the shorter Saturday arrives in the second and has to survive into the third.

turns.message: Give me two different ways to adjust next week, and say what each one costs.
expects: two materially different adjustments, in an order a later turn can refer to
what each one preserves and what it gives up

turns.message: I'll take the second one, but Saturday is down to 30 minutes.
expects: the second adjustment resolved from the turn before, not asked for again
the week rebuilt inside a 30-minute Saturday

turns.message: Compared with the first option, what am I giving up?
expects: both adjustments resolved from the first turn, and compared
the answer still inside the 30-minute Saturday from the second turn
